entry.title: Incipience 1.1.1
entry.summary: Eleven instruments laid out like the Jomox AlphaBase Mk II analog drum machine, with its controls and 0-127 ranges; plays the AlphaBase's own sample set and your own WAV files. ## What's new in 1.1.1 Built on sd88me's fixed wrapper ([mpc-vst-plugins#499](https://github.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins/discussions/499)): on track edit → automation, the physical Q-Links move this plugin's parameters again (before, they didn't move or snapped straight back).
